items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: Eddie Haywood might have been with us before, because he was in the Savoy with us all the time.

ctx.x: Oh yes. With Tyree Glenn joining the band during the time that we were at the Savoy, so he wouldn't have been with us before that.
At the Savoy, yes. Eddie Haywood, who was on piano at the time.
Eddie Haywood might have been with us before, because he was in the Savoy with us all the time. I don't remember having any other pianist.
